description: This is a test script for validating the HAL API CcspHalEthSwGetPortAdminStatus() with an invalid port ID, using the tdklib testing framework. It loads the halethsw module, invokes the API with port 100, checks for failure, and unloads the module.

classes.name: TDKScriptingLibrary
classes.description: A wrapper class for TDK scripting library providing methods to load modules, create test steps, and manage test execution.

methods.name: configureTestCase
methods.description: Configures the test case with DUT IP, port, and test name.

methods.name: getLoadModuleResult
methods.description: Retrieves the status of the module load operation.

methods.name: createTestStep
methods.description: Creates a test step object for executing specific test functions.

methods.name: setLoadModuleStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the module loading process.

methods.name: unloadModule
methods.description: Unloads the specified module after test completion.
